description: Audit routed traces and arcs in a .kicad_pcb or .dsn board against commercial fab minimum trace width limits (JLCPCB, PCBWay, Sierra). Call before Gerber export or after manual edits. Accepts pcb_text or project_path plus fab_tier ('standard_2l', 'standard_4l', 'fine_hdi'). Returns JSON dfm_passed and min_observed_trace_width_mm. Example: fab_tier='standard_4l'.

fab_tier.description: Target fabrication rule tier (standard_2l, standard_4l, or fine_hdi).

pcb_text.description: Raw UTF-8 .kicad_pcb or .dsn text with routed copper.

project_path.description: Local filesystem path to .kicad_pcb or .dsn (STDIO mode).

name: audit_pcb_dfm_rules
title: Audit PCB DFM Fabrication Rules
